purpose: Seed registry for nationwide observed EV charging-session acquisition. Candidate status does not imply licensing, access, or site-level session availability.

national_candidates.name: Joint Office EV-ChART
national_candidates.notes: Quarterly charging-session data are collected for federally funded infrastructure. Raw portal access is limited to funding recipients/authorized parties; public outputs are aggregated/anonymized. Hunt state recipient publications and public reports, not restricted raw records.

national_candidates.name: DOE Livewire / EV WATTS
national_candidates.notes: Federal/public national EV charging resource. OpenEnergyHub metadata currently exposes no explicit dataset license and its record API is not publicly queryable; project materials say a free LiveWire account is used to download. Do not bypass access controls or assume commercial redistribution rights. Resolve dataset-specific license/access before commercial RIVET ingest.

national_candidates.name: California Energy Commission funded-project reporting
national_candidates.notes: CEC-funded projects submit detailed utilization/session data. Individual-charger utilization may be confidential, but public grant/project reports can contain publishable site/project aggregates.

national_candidates.name: Stable Auto
national_candidates.notes: Markets nationwide utilization intelligence based on real charging operating data. Requires commercial evaluation and explicit purchasing authority before any paid integration.

national_candidates.name: AFDC charging-network directory
national_candidates.notes: Strong national inventory/network directory for identifying operators and station IDs. Inventory is not session telemetry and must never be promoted to observed usage.

national_candidates.name: Seattle SDOT EVCROW Evaluation Report
national_candidates.notes: Official Seattle report publishes monthly observed session counts and kWh for two Seattle City Light DC fast chargers on the 2500 block of 16th Ave S near Beacon Hill station for 2018. Site is block-resolved rather than exact charger GPS. Strong immediate RIVET ingest candidate with block-level spatial precision disclosure.

national_candidates.name: Austin Energy FY2026 Q1 EV Charging Network
national_candidates.notes: Current public Austin Energy reporting publishes monthly network session totals, average energy dispensed and charging-time context. Useful market evidence, but not site-resolved and therefore does not satisfy RIVET observed-session coverage for a specific address.

national_candidates.name: ACN-Data
national_candidates.notes: Excellent session-level fields and site IDs, but registration terms state educational and research use only. Do not ingest into commercial RIVET reports without separate permission or changed terms.

national_candidates.name: Seattle EVCROW Beacon Hill DCFC
national_candidates.notes: Monthly 2018 values: sessions [22,63,80,93,121,80,180,129,130,145,178,200]; kWh [130,721,946,1083,1309,796,1826,1499,1638,1543,1861,2155]. Official report states 3.2 average sessions/day across the period.
